content.title: Savo, Schalk, Corsini, Warner, Gillespie, O'Grodnick & Fisher | Savo Schalk - Central NJ Lawyers
content.metaDescription: At Savo, Schalk, Corsini, Warner, Gillespie, O’Grodnick & Fisher, we regard the representation of our clients as an honor, a privilege and a steadfast responsibility.
h1: NEW JERSEY BUSINESS AND INDIVIDUAL SERVICES ATTORNEYS
businessNames: Savo, Schalk, Gillespie, O'Grodnick & Fisher, P.A.
Savo, Schalk, Corsini, Gillespie, O’Grodnick & Fisher, PA
Savo, Schalk, Corsini, Warner, Gillespie, O’Grodnick & Fisher, P.A

findings.title: Server runs PHP 7.4.33, which stopped getting security fixes 2022-11-28
findings.detail: PHP 7.4 has been end-of-life for 1459 days. Hosts are retiring it, and WordPress, plugins and themes increasingly require PHP 8.
findings.fix: Move the site to PHP 8.3+ with a theme and plugins tested on it.

findings.title: Custom classic theme "Savo Schalk" v1.0.0 (built on Underscores)
findings.detail: A one-off theme by cws that nobody maintains. Classic PHP themes of this age commonly use functions removed or made stricter in PHP 8 (each(), create_function(), count() on non-arrays, required-after-optional parameters), which turn into fatal errors after a PHP upgrade. Its PHP source isn't public, so the exact breakages can only be confirmed with server access.
findings.fix: Replace it with a block theme (theme.json + patterns) that has no custom PHP beyond a few lines, tested on PHP 8.3.

findings.title: Theme ships its own jQuery 1.11.1
findings.detail: jQuery before 3.5.0 has known cross-site-scripting flaws (CVE-2020-11022, CVE-2020-11023), and this copy bypasses the up-to-date jQuery that WordPress provides.
findings.fix: Drop the bundled copy; a block theme needs no jQuery at all.

findings.title: Bootstrap 3.3.7 (end of life since 2019)
findings.detail: Versions before 3.4.1 have known XSS issues (CVE-2018-14040/14041/14042, CVE-2019-8331).
findings.fix: Replace with theme.json layout and core blocks.

findings.title: 3 link labels point to two different pages
findings.detail: For example: "Government Affairs and Election Law", "Workers Compensation", "Construction Litigation". Visitors and search engines see duplicate, competing pages.
findings.fix: Merge the duplicates and redirect the old URLs.

findings.title: The firm's name appears 4 different ways in the site's own data
findings.detail: "Savo Schalk - Central NJ Lawyers" vs "Savo, Schalk, Gillespie, O'Grodnick & Fisher, P.A." vs "Savo, Schalk, Corsini, Gillespie, O’Grodnick & Fisher, PA" vs "Savo, Schalk, Corsini, Warner, Gillespie, O’Grodnick & Fisher, P.A"
findings.fix: Use one exact legal name everywhere (schema.org, footer, logo alt, directory listings) for local search.

findings.title: Server announces its PHP version to everyone
findings.detail: Every response carries "X-Powered-By: PHP/7.4.33", which tells attackers exactly which unpatched version to target.
findings.fix: Turn off expose_php on the new host.

findings.title: No HSTS header
findings.detail: Browsers aren't told to always use HTTPS.
findings.fix: Enable HSTS on the new host.

findings.title: XML-RPC endpoint is open
findings.detail: xmlrpc.php is a common brute-force target and is rarely needed.
findings.fix: Disable XML-RPC unless the Jetpack app or a publishing tool needs it.

findings.title: 4 of 23 homepage images have no alt text
findings.detail: Screen-reader users hear nothing for these, and ADA-related website demand letters often cite missing alt text.
findings.fix: Give every meaningful image alt text; mark decorative ones as such.

findings.title: Footer says © 2022
findings.detail: Signals an unmaintained site to visitors.

findings.title: 11 pages untouched for 3+ years
findings.detail: privacy-policy (2018-02-14), disclaimer (2018-02-14), site-map (2018-02-14), appellate-decisions (2018-02-21), testimonials (2018-10-26), our-attorneys (2018-10-26)
findings.fix: Review and refresh during the migration.
